purpose: Teach: 早口/あだ名/ニュータウン/ドレッシング/餡/整頓/ポップアップ/シルエット

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お話する時、絶対、早口、絶対、で、絶対、ごめんね
lines.en: Sho, listen — when Mei talks to you, I get all rushed and rambling. Sorry about that.
lines.style: Warm, self-aware laugh underneath. Opening apology lands soft. Slightly breathless from knowing she does this. Affectionate at the edges.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくのクラスメートの、絶対、あだ名、絶対、ぴーちゃんなんだ
lines.en: Mei-san, did you know my classmate goes by Pi-chan? That's his actual nickname.
lines.style: Bright, conversational. Eager to share something he thinks Mei will find interesting. Matter-of-fact delivery, like he's offering her a small gift.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんが、本気で、絶対、住んでる、絶対、ニュータウン、絶対、緑が多いのよ、翔くん
lines.en: The neighborhood where Mei lives — it's got so much greenery, Sho. It's really pretty.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly dreamy. Gaze drifting inward. Warm and inviting, like she's describing something she loves. Slow pace, letting the image sit.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの作る、本気で、絶対、ドレッシング、絶対、ぼく、絶対、大好き
lines.en: The salad dressing you make, Mei-san — I love it so much.
lines.style: Direct, honest affection. No performance. Simple and genuine. Quick, warm smile in the voice. The kind of thing he says because he means it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、餡、絶対、を使った、絶対、お菓子、絶対、作るのが、絶対、好きよ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Mei really likes making sweets with red bean paste, Sho. There's something special about it.
lines.style: Tender, almost meditative. Slight fondness when mentioning the sweets. Pace unhurried. A small, genuine smile underneath — this is something real to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、お家、絶対、整頓、絶対、されてて、絶対、いつも、絶対、綺麗だね
lines.en: Your apartment is always so clean and organized, Mei-san. It's really nice.
lines.style: Sincere observation without flattery. Quiet admiration. Steady, clear voice. The kind of noticing that comes from actually paying attention.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんのスマホ、本気で、絶対、ポップアップ、絶対、通知、絶対、消し方、絶対、覚えたいわ、翔くん
lines.en: I really should figure out how to turn off those popup notifications on my phone, Sho. It's driving me crazy.
lines.style: Wry, slightly exasperated with herself. A small, self-deprecating laugh. Conversational complaint with warmth underneath. The voice of someone amused by her own minor incompetence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、シルエット、絶対、夕日に、絶対、綺麗だったよ
lines.en: Your silhouette against the sunset was really beautiful, Mei-san.
lines.style: Soft, genuine wonder. Shy but not hesitant — he's saying something true. Quiet trailing-off at the end. The voice of a kid noticing something he wanted to remember.
